question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (SpaceX)

calls.reasoning: Resolves on SpaceX Q3 2026 total revenue (quarter ended Sep 30, report expected Nov 3-17). Q2 2026 was $7.81B, a 13-15% beat. Q3 is the first full quarter of Anthropic's $1.25B/month compute payments (~$3.75B), plus ~1.5 months of Cursor and Starlink growth.
